export.description: Writes the device in the library format to a folder, ready for a pull request.

settings.title: Demo pack settings

groups.title: DALI groups
groups.description: Up to 16 groups. A lamp is only measured if it belongs to a group.

groups.invalid: Check id (1–16, unique), name, lamps (1–64) and levels (0–100, min ≤ max).

inputs.title: Digital inputs
inputs.description: Up to 10 inputs. The title is the measurement's name in Cumulocity (fragment), the series is the item id.
inputs.invalid: Check numbers (1–10, unique) and the numeric fields.

custom.title: Custom slaves and items
custom.description: Stored on this device only. Included when you export it to the library.
